ModMetaData.name: Multiplayer Bodge Jobs
ModMetaData.author: Zapdude; based on Multiplayer Compatibility by the RimWorld Multiplayer Team
ModMetaData.description:
Multiplayer Bodge Jobs: a fork of Multiplayer Compatibility for RimWorld 1.7, maintained in the Multiplayer Bodge Jobs repository. Built from the MIT-licensed project at https://github.com/rwmt/Multiplayer-Compatibility; the 1.7 module code was recovered from the temporary 1.7 build (workshop 3820003665). See NOTICE.md for provenance and PATCHES.md for the changes this fork carries.
Do not enable this together with the original Multiplayer Compatibility. This fork carries its own package id, so the game will not stop you.
Requires Multiplayer Bodged, the 1.7 fork of Multiplayer.
Adds sync for the customization commit of Persona Weapons Unbound and Unique Weapons Unbound.
